key.sophisticatedbuilding.next_power_lev: Increase your Power Level by crafting and consuming Reach Upgrades 1, 2 and 3 (in this order). Operators can also set it with /powerlevel.
item.sophisticatedbuilding.building_upgr: Place up to %d blocks at once from backpack inventory
Place in a backpack upgrade slot
sophisticatedcore.gui.error.add.building: Only one building upgrade can be installed per backpack
sophisticatedbuilding.modedescription.no: Disable mod and use vanilla placement rules
Like vanilla, but with increased reach and placement preview
sophisticatedbuilding.modedescription.py: Build a pyramid with a rectangular base. Click to set one corner, drag to set the opposite corner, then set the height.
sophisticatedbuilding.modedescription.co: Build a cone with a circular base. Click to set the center/corner, drag to set the radius, then set the height.
sophisticatedbuilding.modedescription.te: Build natural-looking terrain shapes. Click to set center, drag to set radius, then set the maximum height. Switch between Mound, Slope, Flat, Mountain, and Wall shapes.
sophisticatedbuilding.action.open_player: Preview and performance settings of Sophisticated Building (only for you, saved in the client config).
sophisticatedbuilding.action.replace_onl: You will only place blocks where there was air. Replaceables such as grass will still be replaced.
sophisticatedbuilding.action.replace_blo: You will replace blocks and air.
sophisticatedbuilding.action.replace_onl: You will only replace blocks, not air.
sophisticatedbuilding.action.replace_fil: You will only replace blocks that match the block in your offhand. If you don't have a block in your offhand, you will only replace air. If you have a randomizer bag in your offhand, you will only replace blocks that are contained in the bag.
sophisticatedbuilding.action.toggle_prot: If enabled, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers will not be replaced.
sophisticatedbuilding.action.toggle_mini: Show a small transparent preview block so its rotation is easy to read.

sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.re: Set every setting on this screen back to its default. Done saves the change.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.sh: Show previews of the blocks while placing them. Disable for better performance on low-end systems.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.on: Show block previews only when actively using a build mode. Reduces visual clutter when not building.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.sh: Show a small transparent block inside each preview to highlight block rotation. Disable if you prefer the classic outline-only preview or want to reduce on-screen effects.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.ma: Don't show individual block previews when placing more than this many blocks. The outline will always be rendered regardless of this setting. Lower values improve performance for large builds.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.ap: How long it takes for a block to appear when placed, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Set to 0 to disable the animation for better performance.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.br: How long the break animation is, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Set to 0 to disable the animation for better performance.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.pr: The size of the ghost block previews: 100% is full size, 50% is half size. Smaller values reduce visual clutter.
Maximum distance in blocks to render block previews. Blocks beyond this distance won't show individual previews. Lower values improve performance for large builds.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.en: Reduce CPU usage when idle: calculations are skipped if the player hasn't moved. Disable if experiencing issues with preview updates.
sophisticatedbuilding.player_settings.ma: Maximum number of mini block previews to render. Mini previews show block rotation inside the ghost outline. 0 = no limit.
